description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'FormsLockedException' used within the OpenMRS project. The exception is thrown when form locking restrictions are violated.

classes.name: FormsLockedException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling cases where form locking prevents save or delete operations within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: FormsLockedException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating that forms are locked.

methods.name: FormsLockedException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message explaining why the form operation is restricted.

methods.name: FormsLockedException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor to specify a custom message and a cause for exception chaining.

methods.name: FormsLockedException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor to create the exception with a cause, without a custom message.
